output.reason: First-trimester bleeding heavier than spotting with lower abdominal cramping at about 8 weeks requires same-day in-person evaluation with pelvic exam, hCG and ultrasound to exclude ectopic pregnancy, which messaging cannot do.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today — an urgent women's health clinic, early pregnancy unit, or emergency department. Bleeding more than spotting with cramping at about 8 weeks needs an exam, blood tests and ultrasound to check the pregnancy's location, since ectopic pregnancy must be ruled out. Go to the emergency department immediately, or call 911, if you soak a pad an hour, feel faint or dizzy, or develop severe or shoulder pain. A Counsel clinician can follow up in this thread, but don't wait for a reply.
